name: tract_developer_style_rotation_and_set
description: Tests 20 and 21, by hand from the NewYear pseudo-code and the SetActiveStyles row of 4.20. Test 20: years between 5, styles {0x2000..0x2003}, index 3, years since 4: one Year message (DoMessage(0x66956817) returns true) -> years since 5 >= 5 -> index 4 >= 4 -> index 0, years since 0. Four more years only count (1..4), the fifth advances to 1. The Month message does nothing to the styles. Years between 0: every year advances the index (1 >= 0), wrapping 3 -> 0. Test 21: current {A, B, C} = {0x2000, 0x2001, 0x2002} at index 1 (B), years since 3: set {B, D, B} = {0x2001, 0x2003, 0x2001} -> idx starts at 1 (< 3), the last element equal to B is index 2 -> index 2; years since is not reset. Set {D} -> idx 0 (2 is not < 1) and B is not in {D} -> 0. Set {D, D, D} -> index 2 (the last match of D). Empty current list ([choice] for the quirk: no current style, so no search): set {A, B} keeps idx 0. Index out of range in the current list (5 with 2 styles): idx 0, no current style -> 0. GetCurrentStyle of an empty list is 0.
